name: Gut-Safe "Yum Yum" / Burger Sauce
whyItWorks: Provides creamy, tangy hibachi and burger flavor using smooth powders instead of raw onion or pickle chunks.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk 1/2 cup mayo + 1 tbsp smooth ketchup + 1 tsp melted butter + 1/2 tsp garlic powder + 1/2 tsp onion powder + 1 tsp sugar + splash of water.
